554c01c9451fbb1457a3dbbf64f167d3a47d151b.summary: Red Canary's 2025 Threat Detection Report reviews threats it detected at customers in 2024, about 93,000 confirmed. Topics include ransomware precursors, initial access via fake CAPTCHA paste-and-run lures and fake browser updates, identity attacks, edge-device vulnerabilities such as ScreenConnect and FortiClient EMS, infostealers such as LummaC2 and macOS stealers, VPN abuse, cloud attacks and North Korean IT worker insiders. Top threats include SocGholish, Impacket and Scarlet Goldfinch.

55c9b6cdaabaa726a627eed38952ae847eff4f6c.summary: A January 2021 blog post on Doki, a recent trojan that targets publicly accessible Docker servers and spreads via an Ngrok botnet. Intezer researchers say it gives pervasive code execution on compromised servers. It uses ngrok tunnels for command and control, a Dogecoin API lookup for its C2 address, and a host cron job to keep running. The post says Doki was first discovered in January 2020 and avoided each of the 60 malware platforms checked on VirusTotal. Defence focuses on container and host runtime security.

dates.q: since it was first discovered in January 2020, it has also managed to avoid each of the 60 malware platforms identified on VirusTotal.

55d35f01aae30c92469ee79b15148cddda19082d.summary: Report on the US arrest of Remington Goy Ogletree, 19, linked to the Scattered Spider cybercrime gang. He is charged with breaching a US financial institution and two unnamed telecom firms using stolen credentials from phishing and impersonation calls, and with sending over 8.6 million crypto-themed phishing texts. Five other suspects were charged the previous month, and a UK arrest of a 17-year-old is also reported.
